$comment: Test runners of this pack, for `precheck.testRunners` in .factory/config.json (schema: scripts/feature-verification/lib/runners.mjs). Refer to one with "<pack>/<name>" or to all with "<pack>"; runners are tried in this order. `verified` says whether the run command was executed against a sample project when the pack was written.

runners.name: cargo-test
runners.description: cargo test, one run per crate (nearest Cargo.toml). Test names cannot hold a dash, so the story is selected by a name prefix.

storyTag.caseTemplate: a `// {case}` comment on the line above the function

runners.verifiedNote: Executed with cargo (stable) on a sample workspace crate: build (--no-run) and run passed; the filter ran tc_shop_1_01 and filtered out tc_shop_12_01.
